title: Newmark Arranges $66.5 Million Refinancing for ZG Capital Partners’ 836-838 Broadway
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged a $66.5 million loan on behalf of the Sponsor, ZG Capital Partners, to refinance 836–838 Broadway, a boutique mixed-use office property in Manhattan’s Union Square neighborhood.
